changelog:
netstatus 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Provides combined network and gateway status with VPN, public IP location, local network, Tailscale, and system health info.
- Supports commands: /netstatus (full status) and /net (alias).
- Outputs detailed or compact status, including VPN provider/location, tunnel interface, local IPs, gateway info, and uptime.
- Automatically detects and categorizes interfaces (physical, VPN, Tailscale, etc.) on macOS and Linux.
- Checks for VPN connection, IP leaks, Tailscale status, and system/gateway health.
- Relies on ipinfo.io API for public IP geolocation and uses standard system utilities (curl, jq, ifconfig/ip).
summary: Combined network + gateway status with VPN info, IP location, and system health
